pillow_heif.name: pillow-heif (Python bindings of libheif): AVIF through libheif, B12
pillow_heif.kind: wheel from PyPI, installed into a separate venv outside the project (key avif_libheif_python); not built by tools/build_coders.ps1
pillow_heif.contains: libheif 1.19.7, aom 3.12.0 (encoder and decoder), libde265, x265 (pillow_heif.libheif_info() in the venv)
pillow_heif.license: METADATA License: BSD-3-Clause (the bindings); classifier and LICENSES_bundled.txt: binary wheels GPLv2 because of the bundled libraries (x265 GPLv2, libheif and libde265 LGPLv3, libaom BSD 3-Clause); LICENSES_bundled.txt names older versions (libheif 1.18.1, aom 3.6.1) than the ones in the wheel
pillow_heif.deprecated: AVIF marked deprecated in pillow-heif 0.22.0 and removed in 1.0.0 (CHANGELOG): the last version that encodes AVIF; no new builds - restoration from the kept wheel; the manylinux wheel carries aom 3.6.1 and gives other files (REFERENCE B12)
pillow_heif.install: pip install --require-hashes with the sha256 above, or the kept wheel; the venv of cycle 8 was compared file by file with the wheel (19 of 19 equal, 2026-10-21)
